# Crest development build
[Download Crest for Mac (Apple silicon)](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/releases/download/development/Installer-Crest-0.4.0-development-2026-08-17-2c53ff5-arm64.dmg)
Built from [`2c53ff5`](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/commit/2c53ff5357553dfb451957e65cb3fe858433f6ad).
Development builds are signed and notarized, but may be less reliable than stable releases.
## Changes since the previous development build
### refactor: consolidate Crest codebase
Regroup Swift sources around functional ownership, remove dead code and low-value previews/tests, and include the refreshed website, help center, and generated project state.
